sources.title: Piracy monthly report November 2025
sources.text: OOW onboard an anchored tanker noticed an unauthorised person coming out of the bosun store. Alarm raised and crew mustered, resulting in the person escaping. Crew conducted a search, and it was discovered that the padlock of the bosun store had been broken into, and some of the ship’s properties were reported as stolen. Port Authority informed.
